name: Northern Current
scope: Regional Ligurian-to-Catalan Northern Current reference route ending at an OSW gate near the source-described 40.6 N bifurcation, with an earlier Catalan termination alternative. Excludes the Corsica feeder currents, downstream Ibiza and Balearic branches and offshore eddies. Exact gates and vertices are OSW choices; not the full western Mediterranean circulation.
layer: Upper-limb regional reference geography; no fixed-depth or velocity-derived current axis.
time_convention: Regional naming convention from source introductions; not the two-week December 2011 Toulon survey trajectory or a simultaneous whole-route observation.
source_locator: Berta et al. (2018), section 1: formation in the Ligurian Sea, southwestward continental-slope flow recognizable as far as the Catalan Sea. Aguiar et al. (2022), section 2.1: Iberian-slope continuation and bifurcation near 40.6 N.
source_citation: Berta et al. (2018), Wind-induced variability in the Northern Current (northwestern Mediterranean Sea) as depicted by a multi-platform observing system, Ocean Science 14, 689-710, doi:10.5194/os-14-689-2018.

supporting_sources.citation: Aguiar et al. (2022), Strong Long-Lived Anticyclonic Mesoscale Eddies in the Balearic Sea: Formation, Intensification, and Thermal Impact, doi:10.1029/2021JC017589.
supporting_sources.locator: Section 2.1, Study Area: Northern Current splits near 40.6 N; one branch continues through Ibiza Channel, another contributes to Balearic Current.

coordinate_selection: OSW coarse offshore vertices represent the source-described regional sequence. Sources do not publish these coordinates as a full current axis or fix the exact Ligurian naming boundary. The Catalan terminal gates test naming extent, not cessation of all flow. Offshore waypoints are coarse display approximations; fine coastal and shelf-break correspondence remains unresolved.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Earlier OSW Catalan regional terminal gate; tests the breadth of the source regional nomenclature.

scenario_rule: Two terminal conventions crossed with three whole-route longitude offsets and independent start/end latitude offsets of -0.1/0/+0.1 degrees: 54 editorial scenarios; not empirical uncertainty.
